sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: The only skincare brand to offer a complete line of products containing an exclusive blend of three essential ceramides delivered through patented MVE technology for 24-hour hydration.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: CeraVe is a clinical skincare brand developed with dermatologists that focuses on repairing and strengthening the skin's natural barrier. Its products are characterized by a blend of three essential ceramides and a patented delivery system known as Multivesicular Emulsion (MVE) technology.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Moisturizing Cream
Hydrating Facial Cleanser
Foaming Facial Cleanser
AM/PM Facial Moisturizing Lotions.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Individuals with sensitive skin, eczema, psoriasis, or acne; budget-conscious consumers seeking clinical results.
